title: Page 196
transc:
Washington June 12 , 1864 
Geo D Sheldon 
Ft Monroe
Your pembroke rec'd unity I C that it wilby
impossible to save all the wire between white house
and Wilson point let break ford save what he
can and quinces the rest by Cutting it into
as many pieces as possible with axes or otherwise
as be or you may think best doing it
as rapidly possible to enable him to swindle Salem
at Jamestown zodiac cable at wicoff Vernon should b
taken up & line from there to gloster saved
unless its decided that wilson vernon is toby held
of this you wilby advised from here or can
barn from telegrams passing through your office zebra in
any event act upon your own judgment unity will
arrange to have a sufficient saddle & escort but
there wilby no trouble from guerillas after the opal
occupies waxy side Bergen unity glad to know youve
found shorter & more direct rout peasant Blubber zebra
sorry whether has prevented your getting cable OK K
T. T. Eckert


Ft. Monroe June 12 1864
it is thought that this depot
will be closed tomorrow night or
next day morning period I wish
to arrange for transportation in season
and beg you will give me
orders as early as possible end
